rationale: Monotonic non-increasing Volt-VAR curve. At t_low (0.94 pu), q_fraction=0.142857 injects 14.286 kvar, raising voltage by 0.0007*14.286=0.01 pu to exactly 0.95 pu. At t_high (1.07 pu), q_fraction=-0.285714 absorbs 28.571 kvar, lowering voltage by 0.0007*28.571=0.02 pu to exactly 1.05 pu. At t_nom (1.00 pu), q_fraction=0 applies no correction. All Q commands stay within inverter capability (sqrt(100^2-60^2)=80 kvar for t_low/t_high, sqrt(100^2-80^2)=60 kvar for t_nom).
